P.name: Daredevil Impulse
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Style'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 6 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Style:}} For each stack, '''Samira''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|2.75 to 3.5 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pp|16.5 to 21 for 4|1 to 16|key=%}}|ms}}. At maximum stacks, '''Samira''' can cast ''{{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}}''.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Samira's''' basic attacks against targets within {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 200 units of her use her blade, becoming {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}. Blade attacks, ''{{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}}'', ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', and the slash and explosives of ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}}'' deal {{as|{{pp|2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD)}} '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 100 by 5|formula=1% for every 1% missing health|key=%|key1=%|label1=target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, up to {{as|{{pp|(2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20}} {{as|(+ {{pp|(3.5 + (10.5-3.5)/17*(x-1))*2 for 20|key=%}} AD)}}|magic damage}}.
P.description4: '''Samira's''' basic attack against an {{tip|immobilized}} target is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and fire {{tt|6 bolts over {{fd|0.5}} seconds|First bolt at the time of cast then once every 0.1 seconds thereafter.}}, each dealing {{as|17% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applying}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. If the target is a {{tip|monster}} or is {{tip|airborne}}, the attack also {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
P.description5: The empowered attack {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Samira's''' basic attack timer, is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, and cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
P.description6: If the target is further away from '''Samira's''' {{sti|attack range}}, initiating an attack against the immobilized target while within valid range of them will first cause her to {{tip|dash}} toward them up to her {{sti|attack range}}, then automatically cast the bolts.

Q.name: Flair
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' fires a shot in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.description2: If a targetable enemy is in front of '''Samira''' at the time of cast, she will instead slash with her blade in a cone, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
Q.description3: If ''Flair'' is cast during ''{{ai|Wild Rush|Samira}}'', '''Samira''' deploys explosives in her wake that detonate upon the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
Q.description4: ''Flair'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage and will {{tip|applies lifesteal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

W.name: Blade Whirl
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' spins her blade over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, destroying all hostile non-{{tip|turret}} {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} within the area for the duration.
W.description2: '''Samira''' slashes twice during ''Blade Whirl'', each one dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies. The first slash occurs immediately and the second one occurs after the duration.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*2 to 80*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
W.description3: '''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} during Blade Whirl. Casting {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} will end Blade Whirl early.''

E.name: Wild Rush
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy or enemy {{tip|turret|structure}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies she passes through. She also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 90}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
E.description2: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them resets ''Wild Rush's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Inferno Trigger|Samira}} can be cast during the dash. Casting {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} will buffer it to cast at the end of the dash.''

R.name: Inferno Trigger
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Samira''' unleashes a torrent of shots for {{rutngt|2.25}}, '''reducing''' her {{as|movement speed}} by {{as|30%|ms}} and rapidly shooting at  nearby enemies over {{rutngt|2}} at sporadic times in {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second intervals|on average; total of 5 intervals of 0.231 and 5 of 0.198 seconds}} each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each shot, reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 30% AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|20*10 to 60*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*10}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Minion Damage Per Shot|{{ap|20*0.25 to 60*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25}}% AD)}}|Total Minion Damage|{{ap|20*0.25*10 to 60*0.25*10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.25*10}}% AD)}}}}
R.description2: ''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to cast this ability, and targets do not have to be visible to be shot at. {{ai|Daredevil Impulse|Samira|Style|image= Samira Rank S.png}} stacks are consumed at the end of the effect.''
R.description3: '''''Samira''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Flair|Samira}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} during Inferno Trigger, but she can still move. Inferno Trigger will end prematurely if '''Samira''' is affected by any form of {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} as well as {{tip|disarm}}. Inferno Trigger cannot be cast while '''Samira''' is {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}.''
